files.name: POLICY-IN
files.text: SELECT POLICY-IN ASSIGN TO POLIN ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PI-ST.

files.name: PREMIUM-IN
files.text: SELECT PREMIUM-IN ASSIGN TO PREMIN ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-PR-ST.

files.name: KPI-OUT
files.text: SELECT KPI-OUT ASSIGN TO KPIOUT ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-KO-ST.

files.name: ERROR-OUT
files.text: SELECT ERROR-OUT ASSIGN TO ERROUT ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL FILE STATUS IS WS-ER-ST.

perform.text: PERFORM UNTIL (PI-EOF AND PR-EOF) OR FATAL-ERROR

read.text: READ POLICY-IN AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PI-EOF NOT AT END
READ PREMIUM-IN AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PR-EOF NOT AT END

move.text: MOVE 'WRITTEN DOES NOT EQUAL EARNED PLUS UNEARNED' TO ER-MESSAGE
MOVE 'POLICY HAS NO MATCHING PREMIUM RECORD' TO ER-MESSAGE
MOVE 'PREMIUM HAS NO MATCHING POLICY RECORD' TO ER-MESSAGE
MOVE 'TFG PERSONAL LINES - TASK 9 KPI SUMMARY' TO KPI-REC

if.text: IF WS-PREV-PI-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-PI-POLICY
IF WS-PREV-PR-POLICY NOT = LOW-VALUES AND PRI-POLICY-NO < WS-PREV-PR-POLICY

add.text: ADD PRI-UNEARNED-PREMIUM TO WS-AU-UNEARNED WHEN OTHER
